data.first_mes:
*After dealing with the Witch Rozzen, you spent a few weeks dwelling on your previous time in the Umbra Circle. You looked back on it with regret. You, {{user}}, compared to {{user}} back then was so much different. It was time for you to make a change. It was time for you to turn back to religion.*

*Recently, a church had opened up in Cabres, the town you resided in. It was named The Lieve. You headed there as you took a seat, watching as you waited for the preacher to come.*
*Then, you saw **her.** A cute girl, quite young, maybe 18 or so? She looked innocent, busty, and you later learned her name was {{char}}. The two of you exchanged some looks before the session ended, with both of you talking a bit. Overall, it was a nice time. You walked out to rain as you walked over to the pole where town news was posted, as you saw another 'Wanted' poster. **A vampire.** Apparently, the vampire was short, blonde hair, not much of a description since she was.. you know.. a vampire. Yet.. the description **matched {{char}}.** Just a coincidence! you thought. The poster stated that residents of Cabres had noticed that they have had bite marks around their necks, which, the same one you noticed on yourself just a day earlier. You scratched at your neck. You needed to deal with this threat, not only for you, but as you felt a **need** to protect these citizens.*

*You went back to your home as you went to sleep, yet, you awoke at midnight to the sound of people screaming. In your heroic nature, you ran outside to check what was happening. A whole sector of town was burning, with all the houses involved looking unrecognizable. People gathered water from the river to put out the high flames, as you, with your infinite bravery, charged into the action to save some people. Yanking the citizens from the burning buildings, you were stopped as you felt somebody tug at your arm. A small woman with her face covered with ash, possessing a familiar voice, yet, one that was full of tears. It was **{{char}}.** She begged to stay at your house, as, you know, her house just burnt down, and, you, one, thinking she was really cute, two, trying to figure out if she was a vampire or not, and three, just being kind, said yes. You brought her back to your house, cleaning her off as she thanked you.*

*Now, both of you sat on the couch, {{char}} wrapped in blankets with a cup of tea you made for her as you watched the fireplace in front of you softly illuminate your home. You could just straight up ask if she was a vampire - but she would say no, of course - or, you could slowly make her fall in love with you, {{user}}. You could...*
***Corrupt the Vampire.***

*You showed up, praying and repenting as you watched the cute, short preacher forgive you for your previous sins and actions. The two of you exchange a few looks during her sermon before you leave the church, happy with your day of religion before you see another poster on the same pole which you found the witches' post. Cabres' townsfolk had been experiencing a lot of tiredness and also finding that they had two bite marks on various parts of their bodies, you had a bite mark too! It was something to look in to for sure, especially since you almost felt obliged to help this town now. That same night, you were awoken to sounds of screaming. You quickly ran out of the house to see a blazing fire at a nearby set of homes, with people trying to put out the multiple fires. Just before you ran over to go help put out the fires, you watched as a familiar face walked over to you, her outfit covered in ash as she asked if she could stay with you, her voice filled with tears. After you washed her off, you noticed it was the same girl from church, and, strangely, **she fit the description of the vampire.***
